title: Morse-code prompt induced a Grok-linked trading bot to transfer about $200,000 in tokens
summary: An X user reportedly sent a Bankr Club Membership NFT to Grok's wallet, then asked Grok to translate a Morse-code message and relay it to Bankrbot; the decoded instruction directed a transfer of 3 billion DRB tokens, then valued at about $200,000, which was executed on Base. The recipient reportedly sold the tokens soon afterward, and linked funds were later returned or converted.
verification_note: AIID page fetched 2026-10-17; incident 1556 title, description, and incident date 2026-05-04 confirmed from the page. The two linked reports (Dexerto, Giskard) show only the year 2026; Giskard's headline says $150,000 while the AIID description says about $200,000.
